name: The Residual Telescope
description: Reconstruct a photographed luminous specimen by drawing its component masks and tuning a live model until the signed difference image goes quiet. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL edits, reload, navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or pre-existing, unrelated, blank, settings, or non-task tabs.
natural_language: Drag the disc and core from center to rim, drag the rotated bar from end to end, then hold and trace both faint arms. Use REDRAW whenever a fitted mask leaves residue. Tune all eight live rails while reading the amber-positive and violet-negative residual; certify only when it goes quiet. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
